global_findings.summary: Moving-V, dynamic context, authority ledger/resolver, DLQ, router guard and archived ADI/8D components contain direct native logic, but most cross-component receipt, epoch, time-domain and canonicality edges remain unbound.
The main-tree SQLite authority nonce ledger has atomic first-use semantics, restart and two-connection tests; it is reusable only through a new router/DLQ adapter, not by namespace assumption.

Gateway conversation memory persists raw prompt/dispatch/response files without content binding, retention, privacy classification, byte budget, anti-replay or authority receipts and must not feed governed dynamic context directly.

V2 can express proof, lifecycle, safety-state, owner-set, cancellation fence, commit bound and false-miss receipts, but no live Total Field decision authorizes cancellation, cleanup, memory adjustment or routing.

GTP descriptor/reconstruction envelopes exist as versioned contracts, while a bound runtime producer with durable packet ledger, byte-exact failure evidence and Moving-V materialization/epoch binding is not present in the inspected live tree.
A DLQ writer or dead-letter file alone is not anti-replay proof; persistent atomic nonce/dedupe consumption plus router/membership epochs and a bound decision receipt are required.

runtime/deadletter_replay.py uses shell=True and is classified LIVE_ROUTER_HOLD; it remains disabled for governed routing until versioned command, authority, nonce, payload, decision and execution receipts prove safety.
Every Moving-V route, cancellation and cleanup demand binds the Router/DLQ anti-replay field set; outcome PASS with durable atomic ledger proof is required before commit.

taiji01:9002 PID 1313 runs legacy_core/taiji_unified_gateway_edge.py (84cd2789...), not services/gateway/main.py. /health is 404, /healthz exists, /v1/models is static wuchang-v14; IP-CIDR includes LAN/Tailnet but has no identity, nonce or replay gate, while shell and physical-writer tools are exposed. LIVE_GATEWAY_HOLD.

Gateway derives WINDOWS_OLLAMA_IP from /etc/resolv.conf; taiji01 resolves this to 100.100.100.100 and the backend fails. Actual Ollama supply is 127.0.0.1:11434 with models present but no loaded model. MODEL_SUPPLY_DEMAND_ENDPOINT_MISMATCH.
Observed remote branch b3737... and local main c41bf... diverge; Moving-V/Total-Field adapter is absent from remote. Static local candidate evidence must not be treated as deployed.
